name: Shure SM7B Cardioid Dynamic Microphone
description: Dynamic cardioid studio microphone for voice, broadcast, and recording use with selectable bass roll-off and presence response.

evidence.notes: Official Shure product page identifies model SM7B as a dynamic vocal microphone for professional audio applications.
Official product page lists the SM7B SKU and product construction/features.
Official model-specific HTML guide confirms dynamic transducer, cardioid pattern, 50 Hz to 20 kHz frequency response, 150 ohm impedance, XLR connector, and 0.764 kg weight.
Official PDF reference also lists the model and technical specifications; its weight figure is reported differently from the current user guide, so the catalog value follows the current HTML guide.

Downloaded and visually inspected the 1122 x 838 original on 2026-11-11. Shure logo, SM7-series microphone body, yoke, and windscreen are visible; the Commons file page identifies this exact microphone as an SM7B.
The file page caption explicitly identifies the microphone as a Shure SM7B used in an interview.
Christoph Soltmannowski is credited as author and the file page lists CC BY 3.0. Attribution and license URL are stored on the image candidate.
